cursor_developer_story.description: MarginWhy was architected and developed using Cursor's agentic workflows. Cursor Composer was utilized to synthesize sponsor constraints (Zetaris Lightning SQL schema inspection, Meterless H-MEM 8-field record contract, NVIDIA Nemotron inference contracts) into a cohesive non-linear multi-agent adversarial loop. Automated test fixtures and resilient fallbacks were generated using Cursor rules (.cursor/rules/) and contextual prompt engineering.
